name: Alternative hair-loss diagnosis
protocol_ref: S5 — Patchy / sudden / non-androgenetic hair loss (REJECT)
action_label: DECLINE BOTH PATHWAYS — refer to GP
rationale: Decline both products. The recorded diagnosis is not androgenetic alopecia, so neither medicine is indicated.

name: Patchy, itchy, sore or sudden hair loss
protocol_ref: S5 — Patchy, itchy or sore scalp / sudden or complete loss (REJECT)
action_label: DECLINE BOTH PATHWAYS — refer to GP
rationale: Recorded in the last 12 months: decline both products and refer. Older or undated: review against the photographs.

name: Possible secondary / systemic cause of hair loss
protocol_ref: S5 — Hair loss explained by illness (REJECT if causal)
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Review. If the hair loss began after, or is plausibly caused by, this condition, decline both products and refer (S5).

name: Medicine associated with hair loss
protocol_ref: S5 — Hair loss explained by medication (REJECT if causal)
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Review. If hair loss started after this medicine was begun (or after rapid weight loss on a GLP-1), decline both products and advise the patient to discuss with the prescriber of that medicine.

name: Prostate problem (current or past)
protocol_ref: S5 — Prostate enlargement, prostatitis or prostate cancer (REJECT — FINASTERIDE ONLY)
action_label: DECLINE FINASTERIDE — minoxidil may still be offered
rationale: Decline finasteride. Topical minoxidil remains available if otherwise eligible.

name: PSA test on record (no prostate diagnosis)
protocol_ref: S5 / S10 — PSA interpretation (review)
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Review. A PSA test alone is not an exclusion. Check why it was done — if for symptoms or an abnormal result, treat as a prostate problem and decline finasteride.

name: Uroselective alpha-blocker (suggests prostate symptoms)
protocol_ref: S5 — Prostate problems (medicine as signal, review)
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Review. Tamsulosin/alfuzosin/silodosin are almost always prescribed for prostate symptoms — if so, decline finasteride.

name: Male breast cancer (current or past)
protocol_ref: S5 — Male breast cancer (REJECT — FINASTERIDE ONLY)
action_label: DECLINE FINASTERIDE — minoxidil may still be offered
rationale: Decline finasteride. Topical minoxidil remains available.

name: Breast symptoms, gynaecomastia or breast-cancer medicines
protocol_ref: S6 / S10 — Breast changes (review)
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Review. Exclude an underlying breast cancer before finasteride. An unexplained lump or open breast-clinic referral should be resolved first.

name: Liver disease (any degree)
protocol_ref: S5 — Chronic liver disease incl. cirrhosis (REJECT — FINASTERIDE ONLY)
smpc_ref: Finasteride SmPC 4.2 / 5.2 — hepatic impairment not studied
exclude_phrases: combined hepatitis a and b vaccine
action_label: DECLINE FINASTERIDE — minoxidil may still be offered
rationale: Decline finasteride. Topical minoxidil remains available (1–2% absorbed; no hepatic restriction in its SmPC).

name: Abnormal liver tests / jaundice (no diagnosis)
protocol_ref: S5 — Liver disease (review)
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Review. Establish the cause — if liver disease, decline finasteride. Gilbert’s syndrome is not liver disease.

name: Acute porphyria
protocol_ref: S5 — Acute porphyria (REJECT — FINASTERIDE ONLY, precaution)
action_label: DECLINE FINASTERIDE — minoxidil may still be offered
rationale: Decline finasteride as a precaution. Topical minoxidil remains available.

name: Depression or low mood (current / within 12 months)
protocol_ref: S5 — Current low mood or depression; unstable depression within 12 months (REJECT — FINASTERIDE ONLY)
smpc_ref: Finasteride SmPC 4.4 / 4.8 — depression, suicidal ideation; MHRA DSU 2024 & 2026
action_label: DECLINE FINASTERIDE — minoxidil may still be offered
rationale: Within 12 months or current: decline finasteride; offer minoxidil. Older than 12 months and resolved: may proceed — record SCR check.

name: Suicidal thoughts, self-harm or suicide attempt (within 12 months)
protocol_ref: S5 — Suicidal thoughts, self-harm or attempt within 12 months (REJECT — FINASTERIDE ONLY)
smpc_ref: Finasteride SmPC 4.4 / 4.8 — suicidal ideation (frequency not known)
action_label: DECLINE FINASTERIDE — minoxidil may still be offered
rationale: Within 12 months: decline finasteride; offer minoxidil. Older: review carefully and record — not an automatic exclusion.

name: Other mental health history (anxiety, bipolar, psychosis)
protocol_ref: S5 / S6 — Mental health (review)
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Review. Not an automatic exclusion, but decline finasteride if there is current depression, recent instability, a psychiatric medicine change, or self-harm within 12 months.

name: Antidepressant / antipsychotic / mood stabiliser
protocol_ref: S5 — Change of psychiatric medication within 12 months (review)
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Review. Establish the indication. If for depression and current, or started/changed within 12 months, decline finasteride.

name: Current sexual health concern
protocol_ref: S5 — Current sexual health concerns incl. low libido or ED (REJECT — FINASTERIDE ONLY)
smpc_ref: Finasteride SmPC 4.4 / 4.8 — sexual dysfunction, may persist; MHRA DSU
action_label: DECLINE FINASTERIDE — minoxidil may still be offered
rationale: Current (within 12 months): decline finasteride; minoxidil route remains open. Older and resolved: may proceed — record.

name: PDE5 inhibitor or dapoxetine prescription
protocol_ref: S5 — Current sexual health concern (medicine as signal)
override_requires: recorded non-sexual indication (e.g. sildenafil 20 mg for pulmonary hypertension, tadalafil 5 mg for BPH)
action_label: DECLINE FINASTERIDE — minoxidil may still be offered
rationale: Issued within 12 months: decline finasteride unless a non-sexual indication is recorded. Older: review. Override permitted: recorded non-sexual indication (e.g. sildenafil 20 mg for pulmonary hypertension, tadalafil 5 mg for BPH).

name: Hypogonadism / testosterone or anabolic steroids
protocol_ref: S5 / S9 — Androgen status (review)
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Review. Hypogonadism often presents with low libido (→ HL-SEXUAL). Exogenous androgens/anabolic steroids accelerate androgenetic alopecia and blunt finasteride response.

name: Fertility treatment or partner pregnancy
protocol_ref: S6 / S10 — Infertility, semen exposure (counsel)
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Not an exclusion. Discuss: finasteride may reduce seminal quality (reverses on stopping); a man under fertility investigation may prefer minoxidil.

name: Finasteride hypersensitivity
protocol_ref: S5 — Allergy to finasteride / Propecia (REJECT — FINASTERIDE ONLY)
action_label: DECLINE FINASTERIDE — minoxidil may still be offered
rationale: Decline finasteride. Minoxidil remains available — an allergy to one does not exclude the other.

name: Hereditary galactose intolerance / lactase deficiency
protocol_ref: S5 — Other allergy checked against SmPC (finasteride excipient)
action_label: DECLINE FINASTERIDE — minoxidil may still be offered
rationale: Decline finasteride (check the excipients of the exact product). Minoxidil unaffected.

name: Lactose intolerance (acquired)
protocol_ref: S5 — Other allergy checked against SmPC (review)
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Not an exclusion. The lactose content of a 1 mg tablet is very small; only the rare hereditary conditions are named in the SmPC.

name: 5α-reductase inhibitor for another indication
protocol_ref: S5 / S7 — Finasteride 5 mg, dutasteride or other 5ARI (REJECT — FINASTERIDE ONLY)
action_label: DECLINE FINASTERIDE — minoxidil may still be offered
rationale: Decline finasteride. Minoxidil remains available. The underlying prostate indication closes finasteride as well (S5).

name: Existing hair-loss treatment (continuing patient)
protocol_ref: S5 / S8 Step 4 / S11 — Continuing patient; duplicate supply
action_label: CONTINUING PATIENT — check supply
rationale: Not an exclusion — continuing patient. Check for a concurrent NHS or other supply before approving: two supplies risks a doubled dose.

name: Hypertension (treated or untreated)
protocol_ref: S5 — Hypertension, treated or untreated (REJECT — MINOXIDIL ONLY)
action_label: DECLINE MINOXIDIL (solution + foam) — finasteride may still be offered
rationale: Decline minoxidil (solution and foam). No prescriber discretion. Finasteride remains available.

name: Possible hypertension (raised readings / under investigation)
protocol_ref: S5 — Hypertension (review: diagnosis not confirmed)
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Review. If a diagnosis of hypertension has been made — or is pending ABPM/HBPM — decline minoxidil. Finasteride unaffected.

name: Oral antihypertensive
protocol_ref: S7 — Other oral antihypertensives (REJECT — MINOXIDIL ONLY; override if non-hypertensive indication)
override_requires: recorded non-hypertensive indication and no history of hypertension
action_label: DECLINE MINOXIDIL (solution + foam) — finasteride may still be offered
rationale: Decline minoxidil by default. Exception: a documented non-hypertensive indication in a patient who has never been hypertensive — record it, then minoxidil may proceed with counselling. Override permitted: recorded non-hypertensive indication and no history of hypertension.

name: Oral minoxidil
protocol_ref: S7 — Oral antihypertensive (REJECT — MINOXIDIL ONLY)
action_label: DECLINE MINOXIDIL (solution + foam) — finasteride may still be offered
rationale: Decline topical minoxidil. Finasteride may still be offered.

name: Guanethidine
protocol_ref: S7 — Guanethidine (REJECT — MINOXIDIL ONLY)
action_label: DECLINE MINOXIDIL (solution + foam) — finasteride may still be offered
rationale: Decline minoxidil. Finasteride unaffected. Very rare in UK practice.

name: Heart disease or cardiovascular event
protocol_ref: S5 — Heart disease incl. chest pain, angina, MI, any CV event (REJECT — MINOXIDIL ONLY)
action_label: DECLINE MINOXIDIL (solution + foam) — finasteride may still be offered
rationale: Decline minoxidil. Finasteride carries no CV contraindication and remains available.

name: Cardiac symptoms / investigations (no diagnosis)
protocol_ref: S5 — Heart disease (review)
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Review. If investigations found heart disease or are still pending, decline minoxidil.

name: Low blood pressure, fainting or postural symptoms
protocol_ref: S6 / S7 — Hypotension, orthostatic potentiation (review / counsel)
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Review. Not a Section 5 exclusion. Unexplained or recurrent syncope may be cardiac (→ HL-CV); otherwise counsel.

name: Phaeochromocytoma
protocol_ref: S5 — Phaeochromocytoma (REJECT — MINOXIDIL ONLY, precaution)
action_label: DECLINE MINOXIDIL (solution + foam) — finasteride may still be offered
rationale: Decline minoxidil as a precaution. Finasteride remains available.

name: Adrenal mass / metanephrine testing
protocol_ref: S5 — Phaeochromocytoma (review)
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Review. If phaeochromocytoma has not been excluded, decline minoxidil.

name: Scalp condition, broken skin or recent scalp procedure
protocol_ref: S5 — Scalp not healthy (REJECT — MINOXIDIL ONLY)
smpc_ref: Regaine SmPC 4.3 (scalp abnormality incl. psoriasis, sunburn, shaved scalp, occlusive dressings) and 4.4
action_label: DECLINE MINOXIDIL (solution + foam) — finasteride may still be offered
rationale: Recent or undated: decline minoxidil; finasteride remains available. Older and resolved: check the photograph and may proceed.

name: Skin condition — site not stated
protocol_ref: S5 — Scalp not healthy (review: confirm site)
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Review. If the scalp is or has recently been involved, decline minoxidil. Elsewhere on the body only: not an exclusion.

name: Scalp-formulation medicine (shampoo, scalp application)
protocol_ref: S7 — Other topical scalp treatments (REJECT — MINOXIDIL ONLY)
action_label: DECLINE MINOXIDIL (solution + foam) — finasteride may still be offered
rationale: Issued within 3 months or undated: decline minoxidil; finasteride unaffected. Older: confirm the course has finished.

name: Topical steroid / retinoid — site not stated
protocol_ref: S7 — Other topical scalp treatments (review: confirm site)
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Review. Confirm the site of application. If used on the scalp, decline minoxidil.

name: Minoxidil hypersensitivity
protocol_ref: S5 — Allergy to minoxidil (REJECT — MINOXIDIL ONLY)
action_label: DECLINE MINOXIDIL (solution + foam) — finasteride may still be offered
rationale: Decline minoxidil (solution and foam). Finasteride remains available.

name: Propylene glycol sensitivity (solution excipient)
protocol_ref: S5 — Other allergy checked against SmPC (solution only)
action_label: DECLINE MINOXIDIL SOLUTION — foam / finasteride may still be offered
rationale: Decline minoxidil solution. The foam does not contain propylene glycol and may be offered if aged 18–49; finasteride unaffected.

name: Butylhydroxytoluene / cetyl or stearyl alcohol sensitivity (foam excipients)
protocol_ref: S5 — Other allergy checked against SmPC (foam only)
action_label: DECLINE MINOXIDIL FOAM — solution / finasteride may still be offered
rationale: Decline minoxidil foam. The solution may be offered; finasteride unaffected.

name: CYP3A4 inhibitor
protocol_ref: S7 — Strong/moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors (COUNSEL)
action_label: COUNSEL — supply may proceed
rationale: Counsel only. Supply may proceed.

name: Blood pressure reading
protocol_ref: S5 — Hypertension (minoxidil): numeric reading
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: ≥180/110: decline minoxidil and advise prompt GP review. ≥140/90: review — possible untreated hypertension. ≤90/60: review (hypotension).

name: Laboratory result of interest
protocol_ref: S5 — PSA / liver / secondary-cause bloods (review)
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Review. PSA: establish why it was tested (prostate problem → decline finasteride). Raised ALT/AST/bilirubin: possible liver disease (→ finasteride). Abnormal TSH, low ferritin or Hb: possible secondary cause of hair loss.

name: Ethanol sensitivity
protocol_ref: Regaine solution SmPC 4.3 — sensitivity to ethanol
action_label: DECLINE MINOXIDIL (solution + foam) — finasteride may still be offered
rationale: Decline minoxidil. Regaine solution and foam contain ethanol. A recorded sensitivity to ethanol is a reason not to use them. Finasteride does not contain ethanol.
